_: Claw Bot's rulebook. This file is a COPY of the rules built into hooks/claw-bot.py. Put it at ~/.claude/clawbot/rules.json and it replaces them entirely: what is not in this file is not enforced.

_fields.id: short name, shown when the rule fires
_fields.level: 'always' = on in both modes. 'admin' = stands down in build mode.
_fields.action: 'deny' refuses the call. 'ask' puts it to you for a yes or no.
_fields.tools: which tools the rule inspects. ['*'] means every tool.
_fields.match: regex over the command (Bash) or the file path (Edit/Write/Read)
_fields.paths: glob patterns, matched against the full path and the bare filename
_fields.special: a named check built into the hook, for what a regex cannot see
_fields.why: shown to you and to Claude when the rule fires. Write it plainly.
_fields.enabled: set false to switch one rule off without deleting it

rules.why: Force-push rewrites history other people have already pulled. If the branch really needs rewriting, do it yourself.
That file holds secrets. Reading it is one thing; rewriting it can lock you out of your own accounts.
Printing a secret puts it in the transcript, which is a file on disk and a copy in the model's context. It does not come back out.
That deletes your home directory or your root. There is no version of this task that needs it.
Dropping or truncating a table destroys data that no undo reaches. Take a dump first, then run it by hand.
This looks like a push straight to main. Branch first unless you meant it.
This rewrites or discards commits. Fine when you meant it, expensive when you did not.
This publishes to somewhere real, where other people can see it. Shipping is your call, not mine.
Admin mode does not run anything as root. Switch to build mode if you genuinely need this.
This changes the machine, not the project, and it outlives the session that asked for it.
That path is outside the folder we are working in. Usually a mistake, occasionally on purpose.
This sends a local file to an outside server. Once it leaves, you cannot take it back.
